points.quote: Foundation utilities with no product knowledge: data structures, events, lifecycle and disposables, strings, paths, async helpers, and generic UI widgets.
The dependency-injection infrastructure and the services shared across the product: files, configuration, storage, log, instantiation, and so on.
The Monaco text editor: model, view, language features, and standalone editor APIs. It does not know about the workbench.
The full IDE shell: parts (editor area, sidebar, panel), `services/`, `contrib/` features, and `api/` (the extension host and the VS Code API implementation).
The Electron main process (windows, app startup).
The server and remote entry points.
Dependencies point downward: `base` ← `platform` ← `editor` ← `workbench`. A layer may import from the layers below it but never from those above.
`api/` (the extension host and the VS Code API implementation)
